name: Beat the Market: Intraday momentum with trailing stops on S&P 500 ETF (SPY)
author_year: Zarattini, Aziz, Barbon (2024), SSRN 4824172; Swiss Finance Institute RP 24-97
instrument: SPY (S&P 500 ETF). Maven MT5 mapping: US500 or US100 CFD [uncertain]; not verified and not tested on Maven.
timeframe: [uncertain] Intraday; bar size not extracted (full PDF not retrieved)
entry_rule: [uncertain] Trend-following intraday position opened earlier than the final 30 minutes of the session (the typical academic approach), with the intraday momentum signal based on the opening move. Exact signal definition not extracted.
exit_rule: [uncertain] Exit by dynamic trailing stop and at session close. Exact trailing rule not extracted.
stop_rule: [uncertain] Dynamic trailing stop per the abstract summary; distance (ATR multiple or points) not extracted.
holding_time: [uncertain] Intraday, from earlier than the last 30 minutes to the close
trades_per_year: [uncertain] Not extracted; expected near one trade per trading day if the signal fires daily
overnight_weekend: No overnight holding indicated (intraday strategy); not confirmed
signal_window_definition: [uncertain] Session-based (US regular hours). Whether the signal uses the first 30 minutes and whether DST handling is discussed was not extracted.
sample_period: 2007 to early 2024 (SPY daily/intraday history per paper summary)
out_of_sample: [uncertain] Not described as out-of-sample in the summaries read; full PDF inaccessible (SSRN returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch).
cost_assumption: [uncertain] Costs and slippage assessed separately per the summary; per-trade assumption not extracted.
reported_metrics: Annualized net return 19.6%; Sharpe ratio 1.33 (both from search-result summary of SFI RP 24-97)
third_party_replication: [uncertain] None found in this session. Same author group has related ORB work (SSRN 4729284, SSRN 4416622).
evidence_grade: calisma kagidi (SFI Research Paper 24-97, SSRN 4824172; not peer-reviewed as of search)
decay_status: [uncertain] Not assessed. Sample ends early 2024 with no post-2024 test in the summary.
data_source_requirement: SPY (or equivalent index CFD) intraday bars and daily data. Maven MT5 US500/US100 history availability [uncertain]. No options, VIX term structure or tick data required by the summary.
min_lot_fit_5k10k: [uncertain] Not computable: stop distance not extracted. Formula: risk % = (lot contract size x price x stop distance) / account equity.
fn_rule_fit: [uncertain] Single daily position with trailing stop; not a scalp pattern. News +-5 min and FN rules not verified.
bot_policy_compliance: [uncertain] Rule-based and bot-implementable on index CFD; FundedNext policy not verified.
event_overlap: US cash open and the US economic releases at 08:30 and 10:00 ET are before or inside the signal window. Overlap likely with macro days; not counted. Options expiration days not checked.
overlap_with_existing: [uncertain] Index-momentum and opening-move logic overlaps conceptually with Sweep (US100 intraday, same session). Share of trading days overlapping not computed.
rejected_catalog_hit: [uncertain] Not checked. Main session must run python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol with 'intraday momentum', 'SPY' and 'trailing stop'.
base_rate_check: [uncertain] Claimed Sharpe 1.33 on index ETF is high for daily-session momentum. Base rate for last-30-minute and intraday momentum on index ETFs is not computed here; the item must be checked against the project's own Sweep/NQ results.
pitfall_risk: Ex-post selection of best-performing parameter set is possible but not verified; long 2007-2024 sample includes regime changes (post-2022 unknown); trailing-stop rules are sensitive to slippage; index ETF vs CFD gap; small net return per trade relative to cost.
notes: Why this item: the most relevant 2023-2026 paper found for index intraday exposure with a stated sample (2007 to early 2024) and a net Sharpe. Its rule text, out-of-sample status and cost model were not extracted (SSRN blocked WebFetch with HTTP 403). Treat as unverified until the PDF is read.

Alternative A (equity ORB, higher reported Sharpe, not an index instrument): Zarattini, Barbon, Aziz, 'A Profitable Day Trading Strategy For The U.S. Equity Market', SSRN 4729284 (SFI RP 24-98, Nov 2024 repository date). Sample 2016-2023 across more than 7,000 US stocks; top-20 Stocks in Play portfolio: Sharpe 2.81, total net performance over 1,600%, annualized alpha 36%. Abstract says results hold after transaction costs but no per-share figure. Out-of-sample not mentioned. Link: https://alexandria.unisg.ch/handle/20.500.14171/122125. Overlap with the stock-level ORB already found on QuantConnect.

Alternative B (QQQ/TQQQ ORB, earlier work): Zarattini and Aziz, 'Can Day Trading Really Be Profitable?', SSRN 4416622. Opening-range breakout on QQQ with leveraged TQQQ variants. Not fetched; metrics not extracted. Leverage is not allowed for a 5K/10K CFD account without checking FundedNext rules.

Alternative C (gold, not intraday): arXiv 2511.08571 'Forecast-to-Fill: Benchmark-Neutral Alpha and Billion-Dollar Capacity in Gold Futures (2015-2025)' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08571). Daily data; rolling 10-year train / 6-month test walk-forward from 2015-2025 (2,793 trading days); reported Sharpe 2.88 and max drawdown 0.52% net of 0.7 bps cost plus square-root impact. Single-version preprint, not peer-reviewed. Not an intraday rule.

Alternative D (crypto session rules, not SSRN/arXiv): MDPI Journal of Risk and Financial Management paper on hourly BTC and ETH session-based rules, 2016-2025, with 2016-2020 training and 2021-2025 holdout. Asset-specific rules; holdout design is cleaner than most of the list. Found via search snippet only; full text, title and rule not extracted. Listed here because it is the only 2021+ holdout-tested intraday crypto candidate seen. Verify before use.
Forex: no 2023-2026 SSRN or arXiv paper with explicit intraday FX rules and out-of-sample results was found in this search.
Scope gap: search results showed no arXiv 2025 paper combining intraday momentum across forex, gold and crypto with out-of-sample Sharpe. Single-asset studies only.
Unverified vendor claim: a LinkedIn profile described a VWAP-based day-trading strategy under the title of SSRN 4729284. The description did not match the ORB abstract; treated as unreliable.

Overlap with previous findings: ORB family has negative project-level evidence (NQ ORB forward exp_R -0.092 per project memory; Gold ORB retired per project rules). Any ORB-type item should be veto-checked against those results before pre-registration.
